title: Lightly Flaky Dutch Fish Stew
description: A flexitarian-friendly one-pot dish featuring sweetened condensed milk and miso-marinate, this stew is a unique blend of bitter and flaky textures. It is a traditional Dutch recipe with a twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and sweetened condensed milk.
Add the cod fillets to the pot and pour in the miso mixture and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the fish is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the dried thyme and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
